design: Medium-height muscular adult with charcoal-black hide and muted rusty speckling, uncovered triangular skull, four substantial tusked mandibles, cropped thick dreadlocks tied in a dense nape knot. Square bronze-cornered black cuirass with exposed abdomen mesh, two dramatically different shoulder plates, thick belt carrying a circular folded net canister, knee-length dark wrap skirt. A crescent edged guard glaive sheathed along back with handle visible above shoulder; arms folded loosely below breastplate. Stable confident silhouette.
